official_sources.role: Title Number and UPRN technical specification

claims: National Polygon publishes HMLR index polygons
Index polygons indicate registered-title location
Index polygons are held in vector format
Every registered title has at least one index polygon
Poly_ID uniquely identifies a polygon
Title_No identifies a registered title
Title number links polygons to title records
One title can relate to multiple index polygons
Shape is mandatory geometry
INSERT records initial polygon creation date
UPDATE records last title update date
Rec_Status records added changed or deleted status
Index polygons are indicative rather than exact boundaries
An index extent can be larger than the title-plan extent
An index extent can be smaller than the title-plan extent
Title plan and register are needed for full boundary detail
Daily production changes are uploaded overnight
Publication delivery uses ESRI shapefiles
Validation checks zero coordinates area and duplicate points
Change-only delivery contains only the latest polygon version
National Polygon links to Title Descriptor by title number
National Polygon links to UPRN lookup by title number
INSPIRE polygons are a subset of National Polygon
Datasets are separated for manageable delivery and maintenance
UPRN links require an AddressBase-to-title relationship
Some titles have no UPRN even where an address exists
One title can be associated with multiple UPRNs
Title_No and UPRN are mandatory lookup fields
Each registered estate has a unique title number
A title number has one class of title
Pending registration can lack estate or class information
Registered status and change indicator are part of the descriptor contract
